R1.task_text: A restarted app must find documents that are already in Qdrant. Add a method `_read_existing_size(self)` to `QdrantVectorStore` in rag_simple.py. If the collection already exists, it sets `self.vectors_size` to the vector size of that collection. If there is no collection, or Qdrant cannot be reached, it does nothing and `vectors_size` stays None. Call it at the end of `__init__`. Add tests in tests/test_qdrant_store.py that use Qdrant's in-memory mode, `QdrantClient(":memory:")`.

R2.task_text: In decisions.py, change `backends()` so that the guard and route backends default to `jev` when the environment variable TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set, and to `llm` when it is not. An explicit GUARD_BACKEND or ROUTE_BACKEND always wins. The rerank default does not change. Add one short paragraph about this default to ADR-6 in docs/adr.md. Add a test in tests/test_decisions.py.
